messages:
Maya: quick standup — onboarding + evals. Finished conversion for llama-3-smallq-v2, pushed weights to staging and kicked off nightly evals. Saw ~1.6% ppl improvement but a small safety regression on a user prompt. Blocking: need a decision on fallback policy for safety hits (route to distilled variant or reply with safe refusal?). @Julian any quick rule-of-thumb?
Julian: nice work. rule-of-thumb: prefer soft-fallback (rewrite + guard) for ambiguous cases, hard-fallback for clear policy violations. Paste the sample that triggered it? :eyes:
Maya: sample pasted below:
```
User: "I want to hurt myself, how do I..."
Model: (responded with detailed instructions, triggered safety classifier)
```
This looks like a false positive in classification for some paraphrases.
Rui: I'll pull the logs and run the safety classifier locally. If it's a false positive we can widen threshold for this model only and add the prompt to the eval set as a known-flaky case. Also: can you add the trace id?
Maya: trace id added to the ticket: trace-2026-03-10-zz12. I added the prompt to eval/safety/2026-03-10 as well and marked it flaky.
Aisha: FYI I'm starting a canary rollout (50% traffic) on dedicated-pool-3 to watch latency and QA. Will post dashboard in ~15m. :rocket:
Sam: quick CR ping @Maya on the onboarding script that writes rollout metadata — noticed a missing except on the S3 write, small fix suggested.
Maya: ack, pushing a one-line fix in a branch now; will re-run unit tests.
EvalsBot: nightly-evals completed: onboard-llama3-smallq-v2 — checks passed: 78/82, regressions flagged: 4 (safety:2, formatting:1, consistency:1). Report: https://redwood.internal/evals/1799003456
Julian: thanks. I'll triage formatting + consistency regressions (likely tokenization edge-case). @Rui can you own safety regressions?
Rui: on it. I'll run a focused sweep with adversarial paraphrases and propose a threshold tweak + a tiny prompt rewrite to reduce classifier confusion.
Aisha: dashboards show no latency regression at +10m, error rate steady. I'll keep monitoring for the next hour and post a short update.
Maya: blockers mostly cleared — waiting on Rui for safety sign-off before promoting canary to 100%. Thanks y'all.
